[quote=ekpatanus;58546712]---

Official Military Report 
Date: February 20,2025  
Operation: Παγίδα αρκούδας (Bärenfalle)  
From:Kingdom of Ekpatanus  

Situation Overview

On February 17, our reconnaissance teams, utilizing satellite imagery and our own surveillance aircraft, identified that the Socialist government of North Arenenge was deploying its forces in the southern region of Raj Island and establishing troops in the indigenous cities with the intent to launch an attack on Raj.

In response to this imminent threat and to support our allies, the Kingdom of Ekpatanus initiated preparations for a preemptive strike against three indigenous cities in southern Raj: Fontenay-le-Château, the coastal city of Orléans-Port, and Amande.

Deployment of Forces

On February 19, we deployed three armored divisions, Πανζερλεγιον Αιτερνα (Panzerlegion Aeterna), and two divisions, Φαλαγγς Ινβικτα (Phalanx Invicta), to attack enemy positions in Raj. Additionally, the aircraft carrier ΕΚΣ, Ἑρμῆς (EKS, Hermes), was stationed in the area for air support.

Battle Report

On February 20, simultaneous attacks on the cities of Amande and Fontenay-le-Château were planned, followed by an advance towards the third city, Orléans-Port.

Phase One: Initial Strike
At 1:00 AM, under the command of General Ελίσαβετ Μιχαηλοπουλου (Elisabeth Michaelopoulou), the attack commenced. At 1:00 AM, PZ_21 cruise missiles were launched at targets within the cities of Fontenay-le-Château and Amande. The objectives included ammunition depots, command centers, airports, and defensive fortifications of the enemy.

Phase Two: Air Support
Aircraft Χαϊνκελ Π.2000 (Heinkel P.2000) and Μεσσερσχμιτ Π.2110 (Messerschmidt S.2110) were deployed from the aircraft carrier ΕΚΣ, Ἑρμῆς, for bombing enemy forces and providing air support. During this operation, they successfully destroyed four enemy aircraft.

Phase Three: Ground Assault
S_64 Τετονικός (S_64 Tetonisch) helicopters, accompanied by armored teams, served as the spearhead for the ground forces attacking the cities.

Phase Four: Subsequent Assault on Orléans-Port
After securing the two cities of Amande and Fontenay-le-Château, our forces attempted to emulate the same strategy against Orléans-Port. However, due to the superior numbers of Arenenge forces, the daylight conditions, and the enemys familiarity with the terrain, after a prolonged engagement, a decision was made to withdraw and establish a perimeter around the city. Exchanges of fire continued until 9:00 AM. Additionally, one Μεσσερσχμιτ Π.2110 aircraft was targeted by Arenenge air forces, but the pilot successfully ejected; however, there is no information available regarding his status post-landing within Orléans-Port.

Operational Outcome
As a result of this operation, the cities of Amande and Fontenay-le-Château were captured. Amande fell with minimal resistance from enemy forces within just two hours. Despite significant resistance in Fontenay-le-Château, our armored units' exceptional performance led to its capture by 5:40 AM. Although we retreated from Orléans-Port, the city remains encircled by our forces.

Civilian Measures and Regulations
General Ελίσαβετ Μιχαηλοπουλου (Elisabeth Michaelopoulou) has mandated that any local citizen who shelters enemy forces or insurgents will be deemed collaborators and face capital punishment. Citizens have 48 hours to surrender any discovered or previously owned firearms to the municipal buildings of Fontenay-le-Château and Amande. Failing to do so will result in confiscation and potential prosecution, with violators reported to Gendarme forces for transfer to Raj's prison.

Peacekeepers are restricted from independent action and are not allowed to use their IFVs and are required to conduct operations under the escort and supervision of Ekpatanus forces. [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]

Casualties Summary
- Fatalities: 251
- Injured: 698
- Equipment Lost:
  - 1 aircraft: Μεσσερσχμιτ Π.2110
  - 2 tanks: τίγρη VI(Tiger VI)
  - 4 utility vehicles
  - 4 IFVs
